properties.notes: The Council's viability model suggests that this type of site is unlikely to be viable to develop. This site has a number of contamination issues that need to be resolved before development can be undertaken. The owner of the site has previously indicated that the current economic circumstances are having an impact on development timescales. The owner has returned the Housing Land Survey form indicating their intention to bring the site forward within 2-5 years.
